```text
126	function eventCreatedAtMs(event: Pick<ExecutionEventRecord, "createdAt">) {
127	  const time = new Date(event.createdAt).getTime();
128	  return Number.isFinite(time) ? time : null;
129	}
130	
131	function hasRecoverErrorClearingEvent(events: ExecutionEventRecord[], submittedAt: number | undefined) {
132	  const submittedAtMs = typeof submittedAt === "number" && Number.isFinite(submittedAt) && submittedAt > 0
133	    ? submittedAt
134	    : null;
135	  return events.some((event) => {
136	    if (!RECOVER_ERROR_CLEARING_EVENT_TYPES.has(event.eventType)) {
137	      return false;
138	    }
139	    if (submittedAtMs === null) {
140	      return true;
141	    }
142	    const eventTime = eventCreatedAtMs(event);
143	    return eventTime !== null && eventTime >= submittedAtMs;
144	  });
145	}

150	 * moved to run B. Conversation-scoped failures belong to their own
151	 * conversation only: mismatch → suppress. Mutations with no run in their
152	 * variables (settings, project-wide commits) stay app-global.
153	 */
154	function scopedMutationError(
155	  error: unknown,
156	  variablesRunId: string | null | undefined,
157	  selectedRunId: string | null,
158	) {
159	  if (!error) {
160	    return null;
161	  }
162	  return !variablesRunId || variablesRunId === selectedRunId ? error : null;
163	}

165	function shouldShowRecoverRunError(args: {
166	  error: unknown;

169	  selectedRun: RunRecord | null;
```

```text
67	function suggestCheckoutPath(repoRoot: string | undefined, branchName: string) {
68	  if (!repoRoot) {

70	  }
71	  const pieces = repoRoot.split("/");

106	
107	function renderTextWithWorkerLinks(
108	  text: string,
109	  workers: ConversationWorkerRecord[],
110	  onOpenWorker?: (workerId: string) => void,
111	): React.ReactNode {
112	  if (!text || !onOpenWorker || workers.length === 0) {
113	    return text;
114	  }
115	  const workerByNumber = new Map<number, ConversationWorkerRecord>();
116	  for (const worker of workers) {
117	    if (typeof worker.workerNumber === "number") {
118	      workerByNumber.set(worker.workerNumber, worker);
119	    }
120	  }
121	  if (workerByNumber.size === 0) {
122	    return text;
123	  }
124	  const nodes: React.ReactNode[] = [];
125	  let cursor = 0;
126	  let keyCounter = 0;
127	  for (const match of text.matchAll(WORKER_MENTION_PATTERN)) {
128	    const matchStart = match.index ?? 0;
129	    const number = Number.parseInt(match[1]!, 10);
130	    const target = Number.isFinite(number) ? workerByNumber.get(number) : null;
131	    if (!target) {
132	      continue;
133	    }
134	    if (matchStart > cursor) {
135	      nodes.push(text.slice(cursor, matchStart));
136	    }
137	    const workerId = target.id;
138	    nodes.push(
139	      <button
140	        key={`worker-link-${keyCounter++}`}
141	        type="button"
142	        onClick={(event) => {
143	          event.stopPropagation();
144	          onOpenWorker(workerId);
145	        }}
146	        className="omni-worker-mention-link inline cursor-pointer underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-2 hover:text-foreground"
147	      >
148	        {match[0]}
149	      </button>,
150	    );
151	    cursor = matchStart + match[0].length;
152	  }
153	  if (cursor === 0) {
154	    return text;
155	  }
156	  if (cursor < text.length) {
157	    nodes.push(text.slice(cursor));
158	  }
159	  return nodes;
160	}

395	function inferWorkerIdFromMessage(message: MessageRecord) {
396	  if (message.workerId?.trim()) {
397	    return message.workerId.trim();
398	  }
399	
400	  const promptedMatch = message.content.match(/^Prompted\s+([^\s:]+):/);
401	  return promptedMatch?.[1] ?? null;
402	}

404	function renderSupervisorActivityText(text: string) {
405	  const match = text.match(/^(Starting (?:worker \d+|planning agent)|Steering worker \d+)([\s\S]*)$/);
406	  if (!match) {
407	    return text;
408	  }
409	
410	  return (
411	    <>
412	      <strong className="font-semibold text-foreground">{match[1]}</strong>
413	      {match[2]}
414	    </>
415	  );
416	}

418	function renderSupervisorActivityIcon(item: Extract<ConversationTimelineItem, { type: "activity" }>) {
419	  const eventType = item.event?.eventType;
420	  const text = item.text.trim();
421	
422	  if (eventType === "worker_spawned" || item.id.startsWith("worker-start:") || text.startsWith("Starting worker ") || text.startsWith("Starting planning agent")) {
423	    return <CirclePlay className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
424	  }
425	
426	  if (
427	    eventType === "worker_cancelled"
428	    || eventType === "worker_stopped"
429	    || eventType === "worker_stop_requested"
430	    || text.startsWith("Cancelled worker ")
431	    || text.startsWith("Stopped worker ")
432	    || text.startsWith("Stopping worker ")
433	  ) {
434	    return <CircleStop className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
435	  }
436	
437	  if (
438	    eventType === "worker_prompt_deferred"
439	    || text.startsWith("Steering worker ")
440	    || text.startsWith("Waiting to steer worker ")
441	  ) {
442	    return <Route className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
443	  }
444	
445	  if (
446	    eventType === "worker_failover_started"
447	    || eventType === "worker_failover_completed"
448	    || eventType === "worker_handoff_emitted"
449	  ) {
450	    return <ArrowLeftRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
451	  }
452	
453	  return null;
454	}

694	function FailoverChip({ events }: { events: ExecutionEventRecord[] }) {
695	  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
696	    const event = events[i]!;
697	    if (event.eventType !== "worker_failover_completed") continue;
698	    let outgoingType: string | null = null;
699	    let newType: string | null = null;
700	    try {
701	      const details = event.details ? JSON.parse(event.details) : null;
702	      if (details && typeof details === "object") {
703	        const record = details as Record<string, unknown>;
704	        outgoingType = typeof record.outgoingType === "string" ? record.outgoingType : null;
705	        newType = typeof record.newType === "string" ? record.newType : null;
706	      }
707	    } catch {
708	      outgoingType = null;
709	      newType = null;
710	    }
711	    if (!outgoingType || !newType) return null;
712	    const outgoingLabel = WORKER_TYPE_LABELS[outgoingType as SupportedWorkerType] ?? outgoingType;
713	    const newLabel = WORKER_TYPE_LABELS[newType as SupportedWorkerType] ?? newType;
714	    return (
715	      <div className="flex">
716	        <span
717	          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-amber-200/40 bg-amber-100/30 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900/40 dark:bg-amber-950/30 dark:text-amber-200"
718	          aria-label={t("conversation.chip.switchedWorkersAria")}
719	        >
720	          <ArrowLeftRight className="h-3 w-3" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />
721	          {t("conversation.chip.switchedWorkers", { outgoing: outgoingLabel, incoming: newLabel })}
722	        </span>
723	      </div>
724	    );
725	  }
726	  return null;
727	}

777	export function ConversationMain({
778	  scrollRef,
779	  selectedRunId,
780	  selectedRun,
781	  welcomeRepoName,
782	  isDirectConversation,
783	  isPlanningConversation,
784	  isImplementationConversation,
785	  appErrors,
786	  conversationFailure,
787	  directConversationMessages,
788	  locallySentUserMessageIds,
789	  sendingUserMessageIds,
790	  expandedDirectMessageIds,
791	  toggleDirectMessageExpansion,
792	  primaryConversationAgent,
793	  primaryConversationWorkerId,
794	  initialWorkerEntries = {},
795	  unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled,
796	  isHydratingConversations,
797	  isSelectedConversationPreviewAvailable,
798	  isSelectedConversationLoaded,
799	  promotePlanningConversation,
800	  onStartReview,
801	  reviewRuns = [],
802	  reviewRounds = [],
803	  reviewFindings = [],
804	  conversationTimelineItems,
805	  recoverRun,
806	  recoveryState,
807	  recoveryIncidents,
808	  resumeRunRecovery,
809	  stopRunRecovery,
810	  showRecoverableRunningState,
811	  hasStuckWorker,
812	  latestUserCheckpoint,
813	  handleRetryMessage,
814	  handleResumeRunRecovery,
815	  handleStopRecoveryWait,
816	  handleStartEditingMessage,
817	  handleForkMessage,
818	  handleForkMessageIntoWorktree,
819	  handleConfirmForkMessageIntoWorktree,
820	  editingMessageId,
821	  editingMessageValue,
822	  setEditingMessageValue,
823	  handleCancelEditingMessage,
824	  handleSaveEditedMessage,
825	  handlePreflightConfirmationAnswer,
826	  isPreflightConfirmationAnswering,
827	  conversationAgents,
828	  showDirectControlWorkingIndicator,
829	  directControlPendingAssistantStatus,
830	  showConversationExecution,
831	  liveExecutionStatus,
832	  liveThoughts,
833	  executionEvents,
834	  activeWorkers,
835	  emptyComposer,
836	  projectRoot,
837	  onOpenProjectFile,
838	  onOpenWorkerActivity,
839	  onRespondElicitation,
840	  onRespondPermission,
841	  respondingElicitationRequestId = null,
842	  respondingPermissionRequestId = null,
843	}: ConversationMainProps) {
844	  useI18nSnapshot();
845	  const { hasOutputBelow } = useManagerSnapshot(conversationMainManager);
846	  const { handledMessageIds: handledPreflightConfirmationMessageIds } = useManagerSnapshot(preflightConfirmationActionsManager);
847	  const selectedRunIsTerminal = isTerminalRunStatus(selectedRun?.status);
848	  // Subscribe to the unified worker conversation stream for the
849	  // direct-control worker. When the flag is enabled this drives the
850	  // Terminal directly; otherwise the legacy `agent` + `userMessages`
851	  // path renders. `null` workerId returns an empty state and skips
852	  // the fetch.
853	  const directWorkerStream = useWorkerStream(
854	    unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled ? primaryConversationWorkerId : null,
855	    primaryConversationWorkerId ? initialWorkerEntries[primaryConversationWorkerId] ?? [] : [],
856	    {
857	      refreshIntervalMs: resolveDirectWorkerStreamRefreshInterval({
858	        unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled,
859	        primaryConversationWorkerId,
860	        activeRefreshIntervalMs: DIRECT_WORKER_STREAM_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS,
861	        validationIntervalMs: DIRECT_WORKER_STREAM_VALIDATION_INTERVAL_MS,
862	        showDirectControlWorkingIndicator,
863	        selectedRunIsTerminal,
864	      }),
865	    },
866	  );
867	  // The single-worker stream above is only the *active* worker's
868	  // transcript. When a run has cycled through multiple workers
869	  // (cancel → respawn) we also fetch the merged conversation
870	  // transcript so prior workers' content stays visible. The merged
871	  // stream is preferred when available; we fall back to the active
872	  // worker stream during the brief moment before the transcript hook
873	  // produces its first response.
874	  const conversationTranscript = useConversationTranscript(
875	    unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled ? selectedRunId : null,
876	    {
877	      enabled: unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled && Boolean(selectedRunId),
878	      refreshIntervalMs: resolveDirectWorkerStreamRefreshInterval({
879	        unifiedWorkerStreamEnabled,
880	        primaryConversationWorkerId,
881	        activeRefreshIntervalMs: DIRECT_WORKER_STREAM_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS,
882	        validationIntervalMs: DIRECT_WORKER_STREAM_VALIDATION_INTERVAL_MS,
883	        showDirectControlWorkingIndicator,
884	        selectedRunIsTerminal,
885	      }),
886	    },
887	  );
888	  // The run's worker list, not the entries loaded so far, decides how the
889	  // conversation is ordered — otherwise the rule flips from seq to timestamp
```

```text
14	function textVersion(value: string | null | undefined) {
15	  const text = value ?? "";

17	    return text;

49	  return shouldConversationFollowLatest(metrics);

74	export function getConversationOutputVersion(

93	    })
```

```text
155	  }
156	  if (cursor < text.length) {
157	    nodes.push(text.slice(cursor));
158	  }
159	  return nodes;
160	}

395	function inferWorkerIdFromMessage(message: MessageRecord) {
396	  if (message.workerId?.trim()) {
397	    return message.workerId.trim();
398	  }
399	
400	  const promptedMatch = message.content.match(/^Prompted\s+([^\s:]+):/);
401	  return promptedMatch?.[1] ?? null;
402	}

404	function renderSupervisorActivityText(text: string) {
405	  const match = text.match(/^(Starting (?:worker \d+|planning agent)|Steering worker \d+)([\s\S]*)$/);
406	  if (!match) {
407	    return text;
408	  }
409	
410	  return (
411	    <>
412	      <strong className="font-semibold text-foreground">{match[1]}</strong>
413	      {match[2]}
414	    </>
415	  );
416	}
417	
418	function renderSupervisorActivityIcon(item: Extract<ConversationTimelineItem, { type: "activity" }>) {
419	  const eventType = item.event?.eventType;
420	  const text = item.text.trim();
421	
422	  if (eventType === "worker_spawned" || item.id.startsWith("worker-start:") || text.startsWith("Starting worker ") || text.startsWith("Starting planning agent")) {
423	    return <CirclePlay className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
424	  }
425	
426	  if (
427	    eventType === "worker_cancelled"
428	    || eventType === "worker_stopped"
429	    || eventType === "worker_stop_requested"
430	    || text.startsWith("Cancelled worker ")
431	    || text.startsWith("Stopped worker ")
432	    || text.startsWith("Stopping worker ")
433	  ) {
434	    return <CircleStop className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
435	  }
436	
437	  if (
438	    eventType === "worker_prompt_deferred"
439	    || text.startsWith("Steering worker ")
440	    || text.startsWith("Waiting to steer worker ")
441	  ) {
442	    return <Route className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
443	  }
444	
445	  if (
446	    eventType === "worker_failover_started"
447	    || eventType === "worker_failover_completed"
448	    || eventType === "worker_handoff_emitted"
449	  ) {
450	    return <ArrowLeftRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" strokeWidth={1.8} />;
451	  }
452	
453	  return null;
454	}

476	function WorkerOutputMessage({

478	  agent,
479	  projectRoot,

482	}: {
483	  message: MessageRecord;
484	  agent: AgentSnapshot | null;

494	    currentText: agent?.currentText,
495	    lastText: agent?.lastText || message.content,
496	  }) || message.content.trim();
497	  const fullOutputAgent = agent ?? {
498	    name: inferredWorkerId ?? "worker",
499	    state: "done",
500	    currentText: "",
501	    lastText: message.content,

504	  return (

506	      <div className="omni-worker-output group/worker-output-actions overflow-hidden rounded-lg">

517	              content={summaryText}
518	              onCopy={onCopy}
519	            />
520	          ) : null}
521	          <CollapsibleTrigger
522	            className="omni-worker-output-toggle inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"

528	        </div>
529	        <CollapsibleContent>
530	          <div className="border-t border-border/35 bg-muted/20 p-2 dark:bg-background/70">
531	            <Terminal
532	              agent={fullOutputAgent}
533	              className="h-72"
534	              projectRoot={projectRoot}
535	              onOpenProjectFile={onOpenProjectFile}
536	              scrollAnchorKey={message.id}
537	            />
538	          </div>
539	        </CollapsibleContent>
540	      </div>
541	    </Collapsible>
542	  );

694	function FailoverChip({ events }: { events: ExecutionEventRecord[] }) {
695	  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
696	    const event = events[i]!;
697	    if (event.eventType !== "worker_failover_completed") continue;
698	    let outgoingType: string | null = null;
699	    let newType: string | null = null;
700	    try {
701	      const details = event.details ? JSON.parse(event.details) : null;
702	      if (details && typeof details === "object") {
703	        const record = details as Record<string, unknown>;
704	        outgoingType = typeof record.outgoingType === "string" ? record.outgoingType : null;
```

````text
export function shouldConversationFollowLatest(
  metrics: Pick<HTMLDivElement, "scrollTop" | "clientHeight" | "scrollHeight">,
) {

}

) {

}

export function shouldConversationKeepFollowingLatest(
  metrics: Pick<HTMLDivElement, "scrollTop" | "clientHeight" | "scrollHeight">,
  previousScrollTop: number,
) {
  if (metrics.scrollTop < previousScrollTop) {
    return false;
  }

  return shouldConversationFollowLatest(metrics);
}

**Lines 189-241 - Primary scroll effect with ResizeObserver:**
```typescript
useEffect(() => {
  const viewport = scrollRef.current?.querySelector(SCROLL_AREA_VIEWPORT_SELECTOR) as HTMLDivElement | null;
  if (!viewport) {
    conversationMainManager.setHasOutputBelow(false);
    return;
  }

  const positionAtLatest = (behavior: ScrollBehavior) => {
    viewport.scrollTo({
      top: viewport.scrollHeight,
      behavior,
    });
    previousScrollTopRef.current = viewport.scrollTop;
    shouldFollowLatestRef.current = true;
    instantPositionedRunIdRef.current = selectedRunId;
  };

  const updateOutputBelowState = () => {
    if (shouldConversationRetryInitialLatestPosition({
      selectedRunId,
      positionedRunId: instantPositionedRunIdRef.current,
      selectedRunHasOutput,
      shouldFollowLatest: shouldFollowLatestRef.current,
      metrics: viewport,
    })) {
      positionAtLatest("auto");
    }
    conversationMainManager.setHasOutputBelow(shouldConversationShowOutputBelow(viewport));
  };

  previousScrollTopRef.current = viewport.scrollTop;

  const updateFollowState = () => {
    shouldFollowLatestRef.current = shouldConversationKeepFollowingLatest(viewport, previousScrollTopRef.current);
    previousScrollTopRef.current = viewport.scrollTop;
    updateOutputBelowState();
  };

  updateFollowState();
  viewport.addEventListener("scroll", updateFollowState, { passive: true });

  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(updateOutputBelowState);
  resizeObserver.observe(viewport);
  if (viewport.firstElementChild) {
    resizeObserver.observe(viewport.firstElementChild);
  }

  return () => {
    viewport.removeEventListener("scroll", updateFollowState);
    resizeObserver.disconnect();
    conversationMainManager.setHasOutputBelow(false);
  };
}, [scrollRef, selectedRunHasOutput, selectedRunId]);

function scrollTerminalToBottom(container: HTMLDivElement, behavior: ScrollBehavior = "smooth") {
  if (container.scrollHeight <= container.clientHeight) {
    return false;
  }
  container.scrollTo({
    top: container.scrollHeight,
    behavior,
  });
  return true;
}

export function shouldTerminalScrollToLatest({
  variant,
  isFirstRenderedActivity,
  latestActivityKind,
}: {
  variant: "terminal" | "native";
  isFirstRenderedActivity: boolean;
  latestActivityKind: TerminalActivityKind | undefined;
}) {
  if (variant !== "native") {
    return true;
  }

  if (latestActivityKind === "pending_assistant") {
    return false;
  }

  return !(isFirstRenderedActivity && latestActivityKind === "user_message");
}

useLayoutEffect(() => {
  const container = scrollRef.current;
  if (!container) {
    return;
  }

  const scrollContainer = getTerminalScrollElement(container, variant);
  scrollContainerRef.current = scrollContainer;
  previousScrollTopRef.current = scrollContainer.scrollTop;

  const updateFollowState = () => {
    shouldFollowLatestRef.current = shouldTerminalKeepFollowingLatest(scrollContainer, previousScrollTopRef.current);
    previousScrollTopRef.current = scrollContainer.scrollTop;
  };

  const handleScroll = () => {
    updateFollowState();
    if (
      variant === "native"
      && hasMoreHistory
      && shouldTerminalRequestMoreHistory(scrollContainer)
    ) {
      onRequestMoreHistory?.();
    }
  };

  updateFollowState();
  scrollContainer.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
  return () => scrollContainer.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
}, [hasMoreHistory, onRequestMoreHistory, variant]);
```

**Lines 2503-2564 - Main layout effect for scroll-to-bottom on activity change:**
```typescript
useLayoutEffect(() => {
  const container = scrollContainerRef.current;
  const activityVersion = getTerminalActivityVersion(filteredActivity);
  const scrollAnchorChanged = previousScrollAnchorKeyRef.current !== scrollAnchorKey;
  previousScrollAnchorKeyRef.current = scrollAnchorKey;
  if (scrollAnchorChanged) {
    hasPositionedFirstActivityRef.current = false;
  }
  const previousActivityVersion = previousActivityVersionRef.current;
  const activityChanged = previousActivityVersionRef.current !== activityVersion;
  previousActivityVersionRef.current = activityVersion;
  const previousFirstActivityId = firstActivityIdRef.current;
  const firstActivityId = filteredActivity[0]?.id ?? null;
  if (shouldTerminalResetInitialPosition({
    previousFirstActivityId,
    nextFirstActivityId: firstActivityId,
    scrollAnchorChanged,
  })) {
    hasPositionedFirstActivityRef.current = false;
  }
  firstActivityIdRef.current = firstActivityId;

  const isFirstRenderedActivity = filteredActivity.length > 0 && !hasPositionedFirstActivityRef.current;
  if (
    !container
    || (!activityChanged && !scrollAnchorChanged)
    || (!shouldFollowLatestRef.current && !isFirstRenderedActivity)
  ) {
    return;
  }

  const latestActivityKind = filteredActivity.at(-1)?.kind;
  if (!shouldTerminalScrollToLatest({ variant, isFirstRenderedActivity, latestActivityKind })) {
    previousScrollTopRef.current = container.scrollTop;
    return;
  }

  const scrollBehavior: ScrollBehavior = isFirstRenderedActivity ? "auto" : "smooth";

  if (isFirstRenderedActivity) {
    const didScroll = scrollTerminalToBottom(container, "auto");
    if (didScroll) {
      shouldFollowLatestRef.current = true;
      hasPositionedFirstActivityRef.current = true;
    }
    previousScrollTopRef.current = container.scrollTop;
    return;
  }

  shouldFollowLatestRef.current = true;
  if (filteredActivity.length > 0) {
    hasPositionedFirstActivityRef.current = true;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    if (previousActivityVersion === null) {
      scrollTerminalToBottom(container, "auto");
    } else {
      scrollTerminalToBottom(container, scrollBehavior);
    }
    previousScrollTopRef.current = container.scrollTop;
  });
}, [filteredActivity, scrollAnchorKey, variant]);
```

```typescript
export function shouldTerminalFollowLatest(
  metrics: Pick<HTMLDivElement, "scrollTop" | "clientHeight" | "scrollHeight">,
) {
  return metrics.scrollHeight - metrics.clientHeight - metrics.scrollTop
    <= TERMINAL_BOTTOM_THRESHOLD_PX;
}

export function shouldTerminalKeepFollowingLatest(
  metrics: Pick<HTMLDivElement, "scrollTop" | "clientHeight" | "scrollHeight">,
  previousScrollTop: number,
) {
  if (metrics.scrollTop < previousScrollTop) {
    return false;
  }

  return shouldTerminalFollowLatest(metrics);
}
```

**Lines 21-32 - Position reset logic:**
```typescript
export function shouldTerminalResetInitialPosition({
  previousFirstActivityId,
  nextFirstActivityId,
  scrollAnchorChanged,
}: {
  previousFirstActivityId: string | null;
  nextFirstActivityId: string | null;
  scrollAnchorChanged: boolean;
}) {
  return scrollAnchorChanged
    || (previousFirstActivityId === null && nextFirstActivityId !== null);
}
```

export const conversationMainManager = new class extends StateManager<{
  fullOutputOpenByMessageId: Record<string, boolean>;
  runLogOpenByRunId: Record<string, boolean>;
  hasOutputBelow: boolean;
}> {
  constructor() {
    super({ fullOutputOpenByMessageId: {}, runLogOpenByRunId: {}, hasOutputBelow: false });
  }

  setFullOutputOpen = (messageId: string, open: boolean) => this.setKey("fullOutputOpenByMessageId", (current) => ({
    ...current,
    [messageId]: open,
  }));

  setRunLogOpen = (runId: string, open: boolean) => this.setKey("runLogOpenByRunId", (current) => ({
    ...current,
    [runId]: open,
  }));

  setHasOutputBelow = (hasOutputBelow: boolean) => this.update((current) => (
    current.hasOutputBelow === hasOutputBelow
      ? current
      : { ...current, hasOutputBelow }
  ));
}();
```

### Summary

The scroll behavior implementation uses:
- **No virtualization libraries** (react-virtuoso, react-window, tanstack/react-virtual)
- **ResizeObserver** for detecting viewport size changes to update scroll state
- **Passive scroll event listeners** for performance
- **"Follow latest" state machine** via `shouldFollowLatestRef` tracking if user manually scrolled up
- **ScrollBehavior choices** ("auto" for initial load, "smooth" for incremental updates)
- **requestAnimationFrame** for batching scroll operations
- **State manager** (`conversationMainManager`) tracking `hasOutputBelow` to show/hide scroll button
- **Scroll anchor key** (`scrollAnchorKey`) to reset scroll position when the message stream context changes
````

## Claude thinking · 2026-08-04T08:49:27.117Z

I'm examining the code to find what's causing the issue. The `shouldConversationKeepFollowingLatest` function looks suspicious—it's checking if the scroll position moved upward and immediately returning false, but smooth scrolling animations trigger multiple scroll events during the animation, which could be interrupting the follow behavior. Plus, when new content gets added and the container grows, this logic might be getting confused about what counts as user-initiated scrolling versus automatic scrolling. The real problem is that `shouldFollowLatestRef` gets set to false mid-animation because the threshold check fires during the smooth scroll when the viewport is still far from the bottom, and then when new content streams in while that animation is running, the layout effect sees `shouldFollowLatestRef.current` as false and bails out—so the follow state gets lost even though the animation will eventually complete at the bottom. Content growth from streaming doesn't trigger scroll events on its own, but the smooth scroll animation is constantly interrupted by new arrivals, breaking the follow behavior. There's also a dependency issue where the layout effect relies on `outputVersion` changing to re-run.

A more robust architectural approach would be to use CSS `overflow-anchor` or flex-column-reverse, or track "pinned" state only from actual user input like wheel/touch/keyboard events rather than from scroll events that get polluted by programmatic scrolls, then drive the scroll from a ResizeObserver watching the content element. Let me look at the actual code to understand the current setup better.

The user's message is a bug report describing a defect with specific requirements — "doesn't scroll down properly" and "it must work" — which reads as an implicit request to fix it, so I'm leaning toward implementing a solution.  But given the ambiguity, I should diagnose the issue first by examining the relevant code, then present a fix plan and ask for confirmation.

## Claude thinking · 2026-08-04T08:50:33.865Z

So the issue is that Terminal's native variant doesn't scroll internally—it relies on the parent ScrollArea viewport instead. When Terminal registers a scroll listener on that shared conversation viewport and calls `scrollTerminalToBottom`, it creates a conflict: there are now two separate state machines both trying to control scrolling on the same element.

`useRunSelectionEffects` watches `outputVersion` and fires smooth scroll animations, while Terminal.tsx watches `filteredActivity` and `scrollAnchorKey` and does the same. A third path through `HomeApp.scrollConversationToBottom` adds even more scroll events. Each animation triggers scroll events that the others interpret as user interaction, causing both to flip their follow flags to false mid-animation since the position drifts away from the bottom. Terminal's 1-pixel threshold makes this especially fragile.

But there's a more direct culprit: `shouldTerminalScrollToLatest` returns false when the last activity is `pending_assistant`, which means while the assistant is streaming, Terminal explicitly refuses to scroll to the bottom. That's likely the core reason messages don't scroll into view—the pending spinner appears but follow gets disabled for it.

I have a clear diagnosis now. The user reported the bug as "it must work" without an explicit fix request, so I should present the diagnosis and proposed solution, then ask whether to proceed with implementing a unified scroll controller.

The fix strategy is to create a single hook managing the conversation viewport with a `pinnedRef` flag. To distinguish user scrolling from programmatic scrolling, I'll skip the smooth scroll animation entirely and use instant positioning with an `ignoreNextScrollRef` flag to suppress the resulting scroll event. Then I'll detect user gestures—wheel events with upward delta, touch interactions, and keyboard navigation—to unpin the auto-follow behavior.

A `ResizeObserver` on the content wrapper will trigger instant jumps to the bottom when pinned, eliminating the timing dependency on React re-renders and handling late-loaded content. I'll also set `overflow-anchor: none` to prevent the browser's scroll anchoring from interfering. Finally, when the Terminal uses the native variant, it should skip all scroll listener attachment and only keep the top-threshold history check.

I should also verify whether existing tests reference these helpers since the refactor will change or remove them.

## Claude · 2026-08-04T08:51:02.163Z

I found the problem — and it's not one bug, it's three scroll controllers fighting over the same DOM element.

## Diagnosis

In direct-control mode, `ConversationMain.tsx:1119` renders `<Terminal variant="native">` **inside** the `ScrollArea`. Terminal's own scroll div is `overflow-visible` in that variant (`Terminal.tsx:2593`), so `getTerminalScrollElement` (`Terminal.tsx:230`) climbs up and grabs the *conversation* viewport. Result: three independent state machines write `scrollTo` on the same `[data-slot="scroll-area-viewport"]`:

1. `useRunSelectionEffects.ts:243` — keyed on `outputVersion`, `shouldFollowLatestRef`, threshold 8px
2. `Terminal.tsx:2503` — keyed on `filteredActivity`, its *own* `shouldFollowLatestRef`, threshold **1px**
3. `HomeApp.tsx:415` — `scrollConversationToBottom`, rAF + smooth

### Why follow dies

Both use `behavior: "smooth"`. A smooth scroll animates over ~300–500ms, firing dozens of `scroll` events. Every one of those hits `updateFollowState` (`useRunSelectionEffects.ts:221`), which calls:

```ts
// useRunSelectionEffects.ts:41 — mid-animation, distance-from-bottom is >> 8px
return shouldConversationFollowLatest(metrics);  // → false
```

So **the follow flag is `false` for the entire duration of its own animation.** During streaming, `outputVersion` changes every token, so the next update lands mid-animation and hits the early return at `:261` (`!shouldFollowLatestRef.current`). The in-flight animation then finishes at a now-stale `scrollHeight`, leaving you short of the bottom — and the final scroll event latches `false` permanently. Follow never recovers until you manually drag to the exact bottom. Terminal's 1px threshold makes its copy even more fragile, and each controller's animation poisons the *other's* flag.

Three more contributors:

- **`Terminal.tsx:262`** — `shouldTerminalScrollToLatest` returns `false` when `latestActivityKind === "pending_assistant"`. That's exactly the streaming-in-progress state, so it explicitly refuses to follow the thing you most want followed.
- **`scrollTop < previousScrollTop → false`** (`:45`) is meant to detect "user scrolled up", but it also fires when `scrollHeight` *shrinks* — collapsing a `fullOutput` / `runLog` block instantly kills follow.
- **No `overflow-anchor: none`** anywhere (only `combobox.tsx` has any overscroll rule). The browser's native scroll anchoring adjusts `scrollTop` backwards when content above the anchor grows, which the `scrollTop < previous` check reads as a user scroll-up.

Also `getConversationOutputVersion` (`:74`) serializes the **entire transcript** into one string on every render — that's the change-detection mechanism, rebuilt many times per second while streaming.

## The fix I'd apply

One owner, driven by layout rather than by React render timing:

- **Single `useStickToBottom` hook** owning the viewport. Delete the scroll ownership from `Terminal.tsx` when `variant === "native"` (keep it only for `variant === "terminal"` in `WorkerCard`, where it genuinely is the scroll container); keep only its top-threshold `onRequestMoreHistory` check.
- **Instant, not smooth, for auto-follow** — `viewport.scrollTop = viewport.scrollHeight` with an `ignoreNextScrollRef` guard. No animation window means no interval where the state machine can poison itself. Smooth stays for the explicit "Scroll to latest" button only.
- **Pin state from user intent, not scroll events** — `wheel` (deltaY<0), `touchmove`, `keydown` (PageUp/Home/ArrowUp) unpin; re-pin when a *user* scroll lands within ~64px of the bottom (up from 8px, so fractional zoom and sub-pixel rounding can't drop it).
- **Drive follow from a `ResizeObserver` on the content wrapper**, not from `outputVersion`. Catches late-loading code blocks and images too, and makes the transcript-serialization hot path unnecessary.
- **`overflow-anchor: none`** on the viewport.
- Derive `hasOutputBelow` from the same pin state, so the button and the follow behaviour can't disagree.
- Drop the `pending_assistant` exclusion.

This touches `tests/ui/terminal-fit.test.ts`, `terminal-unified-stream-order.test.ts`, `conversation-actions.test.ts`, and `sidebar-layout.test.ts`, which reference the helpers being replaced.

Your message reads as a bug report rather than an explicit go-ahead, so I've stopped at the diagnosis.

```text
81	
82	const composerUiManager = new ComposerUiManager();
83	
84	function ConversationComposerInner({

135	  useI18nSnapshot();

153	      : composerBehavior.submitAction === "send_steer"

293	                return;

295	
296	              if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
297	                e.preventDefault();

299	                  current === 0 ? Math.max(filteredProjectFiles.length - 1, 0) : current - 1
300	                );
```

```text
4	type EventStreamStateListener = (state: EventStreamState) => void;

8	function messageTimestampMs(message: MessageRecord) {
9	  const value = new Date(message.createdAt).getTime();
10	  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
11	}
12	
13	function sortMessages(messages: MessageRecord[]) {
14	  return [...messages].sort((a, b) => {
15	    const timeDelta = messageTimestampMs(a) - messageTimestampMs(b);
16	    return timeDelta !== 0 ? timeDelta : a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
17	  });
18	}

20	type RunRecord = EventStreamState["runs"][number];

22	function mergeByKey<T>(current: T[] | undefined, incoming: T[] | undefined, getKey: (item: T) => string | null | undefined) {
23	  const incomingItems = incoming ?? [];
24	  const seen = new Set<string>();
25	  const merged: T[] = [];
26	
27	  for (const item of incomingItems) {
28	    const key = getKey(item);
29	    if (key) {
30	      seen.add(key);
31	    }
32	    merged.push(item);
33	  }
34	
35	  for (const item of current ?? []) {
36	    const key = getKey(item);
37	    if (!key || seen.has(key)) {
38	      continue;
39	    }
40	    seen.add(key);
41	    merged.push(item);
42	  }
43	
44	  return merged;
45	}
46	
47	function runUpdatedTimestampMs(run: RunRecord) {

49	  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
50	}

52	function timestampMs(value: string | null | undefined) {
53	  if (!value) {
54	    return 0;
55	  }
56	
57	  const parsed = new Date(value).getTime();
58	  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
59	}

61	function mergeReadMarkersForVisibleRuns(current: EventStreamState, incoming: EventStreamState) {
62	  const visibleRunIds = new Set((incoming.runs ?? []).map((run) => run.id));
63	  const merged: Record<string, string> = {};
64	
65	  for (const [runId, readAt] of Object.entries(current.readMarkers ?? {})) {
66	    if (visibleRunIds.has(runId)) {
67	      merged[runId] = readAt;
68	    }
69	  }
70	
71	  for (const [runId, readAt] of Object.entries(incoming.readMarkers ?? {})) {
72	    if (!visibleRunIds.has(runId)) {
73	      continue;
74	    }
75	    if (timestampMs(readAt) >= timestampMs(merged[runId])) {
76	      merged[runId] = readAt;
77	    }
78	  }
79	
80	  return merged;
81	}

83	function mergeScopedCatalog(current: EventStreamState, incoming: EventStreamState) {
84	  const isSelectedRunScoped = Boolean(incoming.snapshotRunId?.trim());
85	  const catalogIsPartial = incoming.snapshotScope?.catalog?.complete === false;
86	  if (!isSelectedRunScoped && !catalogIsPartial) {

92	
93	  const mergedRuns = mergeByKey(current.runs, incoming.runs, (run) => run.id);

96	    runs: mergedRuns,
97	    plans: mergeByKey(current.plans, incoming.plans, (plan) => plan.id),

103	    }),
```

```text
29	/**
30	 * Collapse multiple rows that share an entry `id` into a single
31	 * conversation item. The server's unified stream intentionally appends
32	 * a new row whenever an entry's text grows (so a streaming assistant
33	 * message can be revised in place — see the
34	 * `appends changed bridge message revisions so streaming prose can expand`
35	 * test in `tests/server/workers/output-store.test.ts`). It also
36	 * writes the same user_input id onto a newer worker's stream when a run
37	 * cycles through workers.
38	 *
39	 * Coalesce policy:
40	 *   - Keep the entry at its FIRST appearance in the input order, so
41	 *     conversational position doesn't jump when text grows.
42	 *   - Use the LATEST revision's text / metadata (text grows; latest
43	 *     revision is the finished one).
44	 *   - Take the timestamp from the copy on the NEWEST worker, because that
45	 *     is the one the live thread actually contains. Neither "earliest" nor
46	 *     "latest" works on its own: a rewind re-delivers a message with a new
47	 *     timestamp (newest is right, earliest pins it back above output it was
48	 *     rewound past), while `reconcileWorkerUserMessagesInStream` backfills
49	 *     history onto a fresh worker with the original `createdAt` (earliest is
50	 *     right, latest drags the opening prompt into the middle of the day).
51	 *     Worker order settles both. Copies from the same worker — streaming
52	 *     revisions, which share a timestamp anyway — keep the earliest.
53	 *   - Entries without an id pass through unchanged.
54	 *

56	 * worker stream, or a caller that has no worker list yet) the earliest

58	 * it already is.

60	export function coalesceWorkerEntriesById(
61	  entries: ReadonlyArray<WorkerEntry>,
62	  workerOrder: ReadonlyArray<string> = [],
63	): WorkerEntry[] {
64	  const workerRank = new Map(workerOrder.map((workerId, index) => [workerId, index]));
65	  const rankOf = (entry: WorkerEntry) => {
66	    const workerId = (entry as { workerId?: unknown }).workerId;
67	    return typeof workerId === "string" ? workerRank.get(workerId) ?? -1 : -1;
68	  };
69	
70	  const positionByKey = new Map<string, number>();
71	  const placementByKey = new Map<string, { timestamp: string; rank: number }>();
72	  const result: WorkerEntry[] = [];
73	  for (const entry of entries) {
74	    const key = typeof entry.id === "string" && entry.id ? entry.id : null;
75	    if (!key) {
76	      result.push(entry);
77	      continue;

79	    const existingPosition = positionByKey.get(key);
80	    if (existingPosition === undefined) {
81	      positionByKey.set(key, result.length);
82	      if (entry.timestamp) {

85	      result.push(entry);

94	        // so string compare matches Date compare.

97	        preservedTimestamp = keepCandidate ? candidate : held.timestamp;
98	        placementByKey.set(key, {

102	      } else if (held) {

104	      } else if (candidate) {

298	    // Same trim is applied to caller-supplied initialEntries (e.g. an
299	    // event-snapshot hydration) so a long transcript doesn't render in
300	    // full on mount.
301	    const nextEntries = rawNextEntries.length > DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT
302	      ? rawNextEntries.slice(-DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT)
303	      : rawNextEntries;
304	    const next = initialState(workerId, nextEntries, {
305	      needsTailValidation: initialEntries.length === 0 && cachedEntries.length > 0,
306	    });
307	    this.stateByWorker.set(workerId, next);
308	    if (nextEntries.length > 0) {
309	      this.rememberState(workerId, nextEntries);
310	    }
311	    return next;
312	  }
313	
314	  isLoaded(workerId: string): boolean {
315	    const state = this.stateByWorker.get(workerId);
316	    if (!state) {
317	      return false;
318	    }
319	    return (
320	      state.status === "loaded"
321	      && state.latestContiguousSeq === state.latestKnownSeq
322	      && !state.needsTailValidation
323	    );
324	  }
325	
326	  /**
327	   * Latched variant of `isLoaded`: once a worker's stream has completed a
328	   * validated load, this stays true through wake-up catch-up fetches and
329	   * refresh cycles. `isLoaded` flips false on every appended entry until the
330	   * gap is fetched, which makes it unusable as a render gate — anything
331	   * conditioned on it flickers while the worker streams output.
332	   */
333	  hasEverLoaded(workerId: string): boolean {
334	    if (this.everLoadedWorkers.has(workerId)) {
335	      return true;
336	    }
337	    const state = this.stateByWorker.get(workerId);
338	    if (state && state.status === "loaded" && !state.needsTailValidation) {
339	      this.everLoadedWorkers.add(workerId);
340	      return true;
341	    }
342	    return false;
343	  }
344	
345	  subscribe(workerId: string, listener: Listener): () => void {
346	    let bucket = this.listenersByWorker.get(workerId);
347	    if (!bucket) {
348	      bucket = new Set<Listener>();
349	      this.listenersByWorker.set(workerId, bucket);
350	    }
351	    bucket.add(listener);
352	    return () => {
353	      bucket?.delete(listener);
354	      if (bucket && bucket.size === 0) {
355	        this.listenersByWorker.delete(workerId);
356	      }
357	    };
358	  }
359	
360	  ensureLoaded(workerId: string): Promise<void> {
361	    const state = this.getState(workerId);
362	    if (state.status === "loading") {
363	      return this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId) ?? Promise.resolve();
364	    }
365	    const loadedEmptyWithoutProof = state.status === "loaded"
366	      && state.latestContiguousSeq === 0
367	      && state.latestKnownSeq === 0
368	      && state.entries.length === 0;
369	    if (
370	      state.status === "loaded"
371	      && state.latestContiguousSeq === state.latestKnownSeq
372	      && !loadedEmptyWithoutProof
373	      && !state.needsTailValidation
374	    ) {
375	      return Promise.resolve();
376	    }
377	    // Cold start (no entries yet) → tail-load the last N entries instead
378	    // of pulling the whole transcript from seq 1.
379	    if (state.entries.length === 0 || state.needsTailValidation) {
380	      return this.fetchTail(workerId, DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT);
381	    }
382	    return this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
383	  }
384	
385	  /**
386	   * Fetch a page of older entries (strictly before lowestSeq). The
387	   * returned page is prepended to the window. Caller can poll
388	   * `state.hasOlder` to decide whether to keep loading on scroll-back.
389	   */
390	  loadOlder(workerId: string, limit: number = DEFAULT_OLDER_LIMIT): Promise<void> {
391	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
392	    if (existing) return existing;
393	    const state = this.getState(workerId);
394	    if (!state.hasOlder || state.lowestSeq <= 1) {
395	      return Promise.resolve();
396	    }
397	    return this.fetchBefore(workerId, state.lowestSeq, limit);
398	  }
399	
400	  refresh(workerId: string): Promise<void> {
401	    const state = this.getState(workerId);
402	    return this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
403	  }
404	
405	  /**
406	   * Wake-up hint from the SSE stream. The body carries only
407	   * `{ workerId, seq }`; the entry payload is never trusted from here.
408	   * Triggers a refetch from the current contiguous cursor.
409	   */
410	  onWakeUp(args: { workerId: string; seq: number }): void {
411	    const state = this.getState(args.workerId);
412	    if (args.seq <= state.latestContiguousSeq) {
413	      // Already received; the wake-up was redundant (e.g. another tab fired).
414	      return;
415	    }
416	    this.updateState(args.workerId, {
417	      ...state,
418	      latestKnownSeq: Math.max(state.latestKnownSeq, args.seq),
419	    });
420	    this.markWake(args.workerId);
421	    void this.fetchForward(args.workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
422	  }
423	
424	  /**
425	   * Durable cursor hints from global event snapshots. These recover
426	   * from missed `worker.entry_appended` wake-up frames without carrying
427	   * worker transcript content on the global snapshot stream.
428	   */
429	  onKnownSeqs(workerEntrySeqs: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): void {
430	    if (!workerEntrySeqs) {
431	      return;
432	    }
433	
434	    for (const [workerId, rawSeq] of Object.entries(workerEntrySeqs)) {
435	      const seq = typeof rawSeq === "number" && Number.isFinite(rawSeq)
436	        ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(rawSeq))
437	        : 0;
438	      if (seq <= 0) {
439	        continue;
440	      }
441	
442	      const state = this.getState(workerId);
443	
444	      const latestKnownSeq = Math.max(state.latestKnownSeq, seq);
445	      if (latestKnownSeq <= state.latestContiguousSeq && state.status !== "error") {
446	        continue;
447	      }
448	
449	      this.updateState(workerId, {
450	        ...state,
451	        latestKnownSeq,
452	      });
453	      this.markWake(workerId);
454	      void this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
455	    }
456	  }
457	
458	  /**
459	   * Global SSE resync signal. Re-validates every worker we track by
460	   * refetching from each one's current contiguous cursor. A worker
461	   * whose `latestContiguousSeq === latestKnownSeq` will get an empty
462	   * fetch and stay loaded — a global resync is a no-op for it.
463	   */
464	  onStreamResync(): void {
465	    for (const workerId of this.stateByWorker.keys()) {
466	      const state = this.getState(workerId);
467	      void this.fetchForward(workerId, state.latestContiguousSeq);
468	    }
469	  }
470	
471	  reset(): void {
472	    this.stateByWorker.clear();
473	    this.listenersByWorker.clear();
474	    this.inFlightByWorker.clear();
475	    this.wakeVersionByWorker.clear();
476	    this.everLoadedWorkers.clear();
477	    if (this.flushTimer !== null) {
478	      clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);
479	      this.flushTimer = null;
480	    }
481	    this.envelope = null;
482	  }
483	
484	  private markWake(workerId: string): void {
485	    this.wakeVersionByWorker.set(workerId, (this.wakeVersionByWorker.get(workerId) ?? 0) + 1);
486	  }
487	
488	  private fetchTail(workerId: string, limit: number): Promise<void> {
489	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
490	    if (existing) return existing;
491	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
492	    this.updateState(workerId, { ...previous, status: "loading", lastError: null });
493	    const promise = this.load({ workerId, limit }).then(
494	      (response) => {
495	        const current = this.getState(workerId);
496	        const sorted = [...response.entries].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
497	        const latestContiguous = sorted.length > 0 ? sorted[sorted.length - 1]!.seq : 0;
498	        const lowest = sorted.length > 0 ? sorted[0]!.seq : 0;
499	        // Preserve any latestKnownSeq advance that landed via wake-up
500	        // while this tail load was in flight.
501	        const currentKnown = current.needsTailValidation ? 0 : current.latestKnownSeq;
502	        const latestKnown = Math.max(currentKnown, response.latestSeq ?? 0, latestContiguous);
503	        this.updateState(workerId, {
504	          ...current,
505	          entries: sorted,
506	          lowestSeq: lowest,
507	          latestContiguousSeq: latestContiguous,
508	          latestKnownSeq: latestKnown,
509	          hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? (lowest > 1),
510	          status: "loaded",
511	          lastError: null,
512	          needsTailValidation: false,
513	        });
514	      },
515	      (error: unknown) => {
516	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
517	        const failing = this.getState(workerId);
518	        this.updateState(workerId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
519	      },
520	    ).finally(() => {
521	      this.inFlightByWorker.delete(workerId);
522	      // If the server reported newer entries than we got in the tail
523	      // window, chase forward from latestContiguousSeq.
524	      const after = this.getState(workerId);
525	      if (after.status === "loaded" && after.latestContiguousSeq < after.latestKnownSeq) {
526	        void this.fetchForward(workerId, after.latestContiguousSeq);
527	      }
528	    });
529	    this.inFlightByWorker.set(workerId, promise);
530	    return promise;
531	  }
532	
533	  private fetchBefore(workerId: string, beforeSeq: number, limit: number): Promise<void> {
534	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
535	    if (existing) return existing;
536	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
537	    this.updateState(workerId, { ...previous, status: "loading", lastError: null });
538	    const promise = this.load({ workerId, beforeSeq, limit }).then(
539	      (response) => {
540	        const current = this.getState(workerId);
541	        // Only accept entries strictly older than our current window and
542	        // adjacent to it (no gap to lowestSeq). If we'd introduce a gap,
543	        // drop the page — `loadOlder` can be retried.
544	        const sorted = [...response.entries]
545	          .filter((entry) => typeof entry.seq === "number" && entry.seq > 0 && entry.seq < current.lowestSeq)
546	          .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
547	        if (sorted.length === 0) {
548	          this.updateState(workerId, {
549	            ...current,
550	            hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? false,
551	            status: "loaded",
552	            lastError: null,
553	          });
554	          return;
555	        }
556	        const highestOlderSeq = sorted[sorted.length - 1]!.seq;
557	        if (current.lowestSeq > 0 && highestOlderSeq !== current.lowestSeq - 1) {
558	          // Gap — older page doesn't butt up to our window. Don't merge
559	          // (would violate the contiguity invariant). Still advance the
560	          // hasOlder hint if the server thinks there's nothing left.
561	          this.updateState(workerId, {
562	            ...current,
563	            hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? current.hasOlder,
564	            status: "loaded",
565	            lastError: null,
566	          });
567	          return;
568	        }
569	        const lowest = sorted[0]!.seq;
570	        const merged = [...sorted, ...current.entries];
571	        this.updateState(workerId, {
572	          ...current,
573	          entries: merged,
574	          lowestSeq: lowest,
575	          hasOlder: response.hasOlder ?? (lowest > 1),
576	          status: "loaded",
577	          lastError: null,
578	        });
579	      },
580	      (error: unknown) => {
581	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
582	        const failing = this.getState(workerId);
583	        this.updateState(workerId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
584	      },
585	    ).finally(() => {
586	      this.inFlightByWorker.delete(workerId);
587	    });
588	    this.inFlightByWorker.set(workerId, promise);
589	    return promise;
590	  }
591	
592	  private fetchForward(workerId: string, afterSeq: number): Promise<void> {
593	    const existing = this.inFlightByWorker.get(workerId);
594	    if (existing) {
595	      return existing;
596	    }
597	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
598	    this.updateState(workerId, { ...previous, status: "loading", lastError: null });
599	    const cursorBeforeFetch = previous.latestContiguousSeq;
600	    const knownBeforeFetch = previous.latestKnownSeq;
601	    const wakeVersionBeforeFetch = this.wakeVersionByWorker.get(workerId) ?? 0;
602	    const promise = this.load({ workerId, afterSeq }).then(
603	      (response) => {
604	        this.applyFetchResult(workerId, afterSeq, response);
605	      },
606	      (error: unknown) => {
607	        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
608	        const failing = this.getState(workerId);
609	        this.updateState(workerId, { ...failing, status: "error", lastError: message });
610	      },
611	    ).finally(() => {
612	      this.inFlightByWorker.delete(workerId);
613	      // If applyFetchResult advanced the contiguous prefix and a known
614	      // gap remains, chase it now. Requiring progress prevents an
615	      // infinite loop when the server reports `latestSeq` ahead of the
616	      // entries it returned (race or stale latest hint).
617	      const after = this.getState(workerId);
618	      const wakeUpAdvancedKnownSeq = after.latestKnownSeq > knownBeforeFetch;
619	      const wakeUpArrivedDuringFetch = (this.wakeVersionByWorker.get(workerId) ?? 0) > wakeVersionBeforeFetch;
620	      if (
621	        after.status === "loaded"
622	        && (after.latestContiguousSeq > cursorBeforeFetch || wakeUpAdvancedKnownSeq || wakeUpArrivedDuringFetch)
623	        && after.latestContiguousSeq < after.latestKnownSeq
624	      ) {
625	        void this.fetchForward(workerId, after.latestContiguousSeq);
626	      }
627	    });
628	    this.inFlightByWorker.set(workerId, promise);
629	    return promise;
630	  }
631	
632	  private applyFetchResult(
633	    workerId: string,
634	    cursorBeforeFetch: number,
635	    response: FetchResponse,
636	  ): void {
637	    const previous = this.getState(workerId);
638	    // The endpoint returns entries strictly newer than `afterSeq`. If
639	    // the caller's view advanced between request and response, drop
640	    // anything we've already merged.
641	    const incoming = response.entries
642	      .filter((entry) => entry.seq > previous.latestContiguousSeq)
643	      .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
644	
645	    let nextContiguous = previous.latestContiguousSeq;
646	    const merged = [...previous.entries];
647	    for (const entry of incoming) {
648	      if (entry.seq === nextContiguous + 1) {
649	        merged.push(entry);
650	        nextContiguous = entry.seq;
651	      } else if (entry.seq > nextContiguous + 1) {
652	        // Gap. Don't include the entry; the next forward load (kicked off
653	        // below) will cover both this seq and the missing ones.
654	        break;
655	      }
656	    }
657	
658	    const nextKnown = Math.max(previous.latestKnownSeq, response.latestSeq, nextContiguous);
659	    // If we started with no entries, lowestSeq becomes the first merged
660	    // entry's seq; otherwise the window's lower bound is unchanged.
661	    const nextLowest = previous.lowestSeq > 0
662	      ? previous.lowestSeq
663	      : merged[0]?.seq ?? 0;
664	    const next: WorkerStreamState = {
665	      ...previous,
666	      // Reuse the previous array when the poll appended nothing. The spread
667	      // above always allocates, so an idle validation poll used to hand every
668	      // subscriber a brand-new `entries` identity and invalidate each memo
669	      // derived from it — the transcript merge and Terminal's activity
670	      // rebuild both re-ran for a byte-identical result.
671	      entries: merged.length > previous.entries.length ? merged : previous.entries,
672	      lowestSeq: nextLowest,
673	      latestContiguousSeq: nextContiguous,
674	      latestKnownSeq: nextKnown,
675	      // hasOlder is preserved; only tail-load or loadOlder updates it.
676	      // A forward fetch starting from lowestSeq=0 (empty window) can't
677	      // assert anything about whether older entries exist.
678	      status: "loaded",
679	      lastError: null,
680	      needsTailValidation: false,
681	    };
682	    this.updateState(workerId, next);
683	
684	    // Gap chasing happens in the fetch wrapper's .finally so that
685	    // inFlightByWorker is cleared before the recursive call.
686	  }
687	
688	  private updateState(workerId: string, next: WorkerStreamState): void {
689	    this.stateByWorker.set(workerId, next);
690	    if (next.status === "loaded" && !next.needsTailValidation) {
691	      this.everLoadedWorkers.add(workerId);
692	    }
693	    if (next.status === "loaded") {
694	      this.rememberState(workerId, next.entries);
695	    }
696	    const listeners = this.listenersByWorker.get(workerId);
697	    if (!listeners) {
698	      return;
699	    }
700	    for (const listener of listeners) {
701	      listener(next);
702	    }
703	  }
704	
705	  private getCachedEntries(workerId: string): WorkerEntry[] {
706	    const cached = this.readEnvelope().workers[workerId];
707	    if (!cached || !isWorkerEntryArray(cached.entries)) {
708	      return [];
709	    }
710	    // Trim to the tail window. The cache used to rehydrate full
711	    // transcripts which caused the worker view to render every entry
712	    // from seq 1 and then auto-scroll down — bad UX on long sessions.
713	    // We want the user to see the most recent N entries immediately,
714	    // then load older ones on scroll-back via loadOlder().
715	    if (cached.entries.length > DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT) {
716	      return cached.entries.slice(-DEFAULT_TAIL_LIMIT);
717	    }
718	    return cached.entries;
719	  }
720	
721	  private rememberState(workerId: string, entries: WorkerEntry[]): void {
722	    if (!this.storage) {
723	      return;
724	    }
725	
726	    const currentEnvelope = this.readEnvelope();
727	    if (entries.length === 0) {
728	      const { [workerId]: _removed, ...workers } = currentEnvelope.workers;
729	      this.envelope = { ...currentEnvelope, workers };
730	      this.scheduleFlush();
731	      return;
732	    }
733	
734	    this.envelope = this.pruneEnvelope({
735	      ...currentEnvelope,
736	      workers: {
737	        ...currentEnvelope.workers,
738	        [workerId]: {
739	          updatedAt: this.now(),
740	          entries,
741	        },
742	      },
743	    });
744	    this.scheduleFlush();
745	  }
746	
747	  /** Write the pending cache envelope to storage now. */
748	  flushCache(): void {
749	    if (this.flushTimer !== null) {
750	      clearTimeout(this.flushTimer);
751	      this.flushTimer = null;
752	    }
753	
754	    const envelope = this.envelope;
755	    if (!this.storage || !envelope) {
756	      return;
757	    }
758	
759	    const serialized = JSON.stringify({
760	      version: 1,
761	      workers: Object.fromEntries(
762	        Object.entries(envelope.workers).map(([id, cached]) => [id, {
763	          updatedAt: cached.updatedAt,
764	          entries: cached.entries.map(compactEntryForCache),
765	        }]),
766	      ),
767	    } satisfies WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope);
768	    if (serialized.length > this.maxSerializedBytes) {
769	      return;
770	    }
771	
772	    try {
773	      this.storage.setItem(this.storageKey, serialized);
774	    } catch {
775	      // localStorage is a preview cache only; live server state remains authoritative.
776	    }
777	  }
778	
779	  private scheduleFlush(): void {
780	    if (this.flushTimer !== null) {
781	      return;
782	    }
783	
784	    if (this.flushIntervalMs <= 0) {
785	      this.flushCache();
786	      return;
787	    }
788	
789	    this.flushTimer = setTimeout(() => {
790	      this.flushTimer = null;
791	      this.flushCache();
792	    }, this.flushIntervalMs);
793	    (this.flushTimer as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.();
794	  }
795	
796	  private readEnvelope(): WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope {
797	    if (!this.storage) {
798	      return emptyEnvelope();
799	    }
800	
801	    if (this.envelope) {
802	      return this.envelope;
803	    }
804	
805	    try {
806	      const raw = this.storage.getItem(this.storageKey);
807	      if (!raw) {
808	        this.envelope = emptyEnvelope();
809	        return this.envelope;
810	      }
811	
812	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope>;
813	      if (parsed.version !== 1 || typeof parsed.workers !== "object" || parsed.workers === null) {
814	        this.envelope = emptyEnvelope();
815	        return this.envelope;
816	      }
817	      this.envelope = {
818	        version: 1,
819	        workers: parsed.workers as Record<string, CachedWorkerStream>,
820	      };
821	      return this.envelope;
822	    } catch {
823	      try {
824	        this.storage.removeItem(this.storageKey);
825	      } catch {
826	        // Ignore cleanup failures.
827	      }
828	      this.envelope = emptyEnvelope();
829	      return this.envelope;
830	    }
831	  }
832	
833	  private pruneEnvelope(envelope: WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope): WorkerEntriesCacheEnvelope {
834	    return {
835	      version: 1,
836	      workers: Object.fromEntries(
837	        Object.entries(envelope.workers)
838	          .sort((left, right) => {
839	            const updatedDelta = right[1].updatedAt - left[1].updatedAt;
840	            return updatedDelta !== 0 ? updatedDelta : left[0].localeCompare(right[0]);
841	          })
842	          .slice(0, this.maxWorkers),
843	      ),
844	    };
845	  }
846	}
847	
848	// A single process-wide instance is fine because manager state is keyed
849	// by workerId and the same worker is never owned by two tabs. The
850	// reset() method exists for tests; production code should not call it.
851	export const workerEntriesManager = new WorkerEntriesManager();
852	
853	/**
854	 * Subscribe to the unified worker conversation stream for a single
855	 * worker. Returns the live state plus a `isLoaded` boolean derived
856	 * from the manager's contiguous-prefix invariant.
857	 *
858	 * `workerId === null` returns a stable empty state and skips the
859	 * fetch.
860	 */
861	interface UseWorkerStreamOptions {
862	  refreshIntervalMs?: number | null;
863	}
864	
865	export function useWorkerStream(
866	  workerId: string | null,
867	  initialEntries: WorkerEntry[] = [],
868	  options: UseWorkerStreamOptions = {},
869	) {
870	  const runtimeApis = useRuntimeAPIs();
871	  workerEntriesManager.configure(runtimeApis.workers.listEntries);
872	  const state = useSyncExternalStore(
873	    useCallback((listener) => (
874	      workerId ? workerEntriesManager.subscribe(workerId, listener) : () => {}
875	    ), [workerId]),
876	    useCallback(() => (
877	      workerId ? workerEntriesManager.getState(workerId, initialEntries) : EMPTY_WORKER_STREAM_STATE
878	    ), [initialEntries, workerId]),
879	    () => EMPTY_WORKER_STREAM_STATE,
880	  );
881	  useEffect(() => {
882	    if (!workerId) {
883	      return;
884	    }
885	    void workerEntriesManager.ensureLoaded(workerId);
886	  }, [workerId]);
887	  useEffect(() => {
888	    if (!workerId || !options.refreshIntervalMs || options.refreshIntervalMs <= 0) {
889	      return;
890	    }
891	    const intervalId = window.setInterval(() => {
892	      void workerEntriesManager.refresh(workerId);
893	    }, options.refreshIntervalMs);
894	    return () => window.clearInterval(intervalId);
895	  }, [options.refreshIntervalMs, workerId]);
896	  const loadOlder = useCallback((limit?: number) => {
897	    if (!workerId) return Promise.resolve();
898	    return workerEntriesManager.loadOlder(workerId, limit);
899	  }, [workerId]);
900	  const entries = useMemo(() => coalesceWorkerEntriesById(state.entries), [state.entries]);
901	  return {
902	    state,
903	    entries,
904	    isLoaded: workerId ? workerEntriesManager.isLoaded(workerId) : false,
905	    hasEverLoaded: workerId ? workerEntriesManager.hasEverLoaded(workerId) : false,
906	    hasOlder: state.hasOlder,
907	    loadOlder,
908	  };
```

```text
146	export function appendSentConversationMessageSnapshot(
147	  current: EventStreamState,
148	  message: MessageRecord | null | undefined,
149	): EventStreamState {
150	  if (!message) {
151	    return current;
152	  }
153	
154	  const messages = current.messages || [];
155	  if (messages.some((existing) => existing.id === message.id)) {
156	    return current;
157	  }
158	
159	  return {
160	    ...current,
161	    messages: [...messages, message],
162	    runs: (current.runs || []).map((run) => (
163	      run.id === message.runId
164	        ? reviveRunForSentMessage(run, message)

166	    )),

168	}
169	
170	function shouldReviveRunForSentMessage(run: RunRecord, message: MessageRecord) {
171	  if (!isTerminalRunStatus(run.status)) {
172	    return true;
173	  }
174	
175	  const runUpdatedAt = timestampMs(run.updatedAt ?? run.createdAt);
176	  const messageCreatedAt = timestampMs(message.createdAt);
177	  return messageCreatedAt > runUpdatedAt;
178	}
179	
180	function reviveRunForSentMessage(run: RunRecord, message: MessageRecord): RunRecord {
181	  if (!shouldReviveRunForSentMessage(run, message)) {
182	    return run;
183	  }
184	
185	  return {
186	    ...run,
187	    status: "running",
188	    failedAt: null,
189	    lastError: null,

191	  };

194	/**
195	 * A user message rendered from the moment the send button is pressed,
196	 * before the server has acknowledged it. Swapped for the server's row via
197	 * `resolveOptimisticSentConversationMessage` when the POST settles. The
198	 * bubble must exist continuously from click to delivery — appearing only
199	 * on POST success made it pop in late and flicker (see the send-time
200	 * bubble regression tests).
201	 */
202	export function buildOptimisticSentConversationMessage(args: {
203	  runId: string;
204	  content: string;
205	  attachments?: ChatAttachment[];
206	}): MessageRecord {
207	  const id = typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto
208	    ? `optimistic-${crypto.randomUUID()}`
209	    : `optimistic-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
210	  return {
211	    id,
212	    runId: args.runId,
213	    role: "user",
214	    kind: null,
215	    content: args.content,
216	    attachments: args.attachments ?? [],
217	    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
218	  };
219	}

221	/**
222	 * Remove the optimistic row and, when the server produced a message row,
223	 * append it in its place. Passing `null` (send failed, or the message was
224	 * queued without a row) just removes the optimistic bubble.
225	 */
226	export function resolveOptimisticSentConversationMessage(
227	  current: EventStreamState,
228	  optimisticMessageId: string,
229	  message: MessageRecord | null | undefined,
230	): EventStreamState {
231	  const messages = (current.messages || []).filter((existing) => existing.id !== optimisticMessageId);
232	  const next = messages.length === (current.messages || []).length
233	    ? current
234	    : { ...current, messages };
235	  return message ? appendSentConversationMessageSnapshot(next, message) : next;
236	}

238	export function mergePendingSentConversationMessages(
239	  incomingState: EventStreamState,
240	  pendingMessages: Map<string, MessageRecord>,
241	): EventStreamState {
242	  if (pendingMessages.size === 0) {
243	    return incomingState;
244	  }
245	
246	  const serverMessageIds = new Set((incomingState.messages || []).map((message) => message.id));
247	  const incomingRunsById = new Map((incomingState.runs || []).map((run) => [run.id, run]));
248	  let nextState = incomingState;
249	
250	  for (const [messageId, message] of Array.from(pendingMessages.entries())) {
251	    if (serverMessageIds.has(messageId)) {
252	      pendingMessages.delete(messageId);
253	      continue;
254	    }
255	
256	    const incomingRun = incomingRunsById.get(message.runId);
257	    if (incomingRun && !shouldReviveRunForSentMessage(incomingRun, message)) {
258	      pendingMessages.delete(messageId);
259	      continue;
260	    }
261	
262	    nextState = appendSentConversationMessageSnapshot(nextState, message);
263	  }
264	
265	  return nextState;
266	}

286	export function buildOptimisticCreatedConversationSnapshot(args: {

306	    },

309	      planId,
310	      mode: storedMode,

323	export function appendCreatedConversationSnapshot(
324	  current: EventStreamState,
325	  snapshot: CreatedConversationSnapshot | null | undefined,
326	): EventStreamState {
327	  const run = snapshot?.run;
328	  if (!run) {
329	    return current;
330	  }
331	
332	  const plan = snapshot.plan;
333	  const message = snapshot.message;
334	  const currentRuns = current.runs || [];
335	  const existingRun = currentRuns.find((candidate) => candidate.id === run.id);
336	  const optimisticPlanId = `${run.id}:optimistic-plan`;
337	  const replacedOptimisticPlanId = existingRun?.planId === optimisticPlanId && run.planId !== optimisticPlanId
338	    ? optimisticPlanId
339	    : null;
340	  const currentPlans = replacedOptimisticPlanId
341	    ? (current.plans || []).filter((existingPlan) => existingPlan.id !== replacedOptimisticPlanId)
342	    : current.plans || [];
343	  const nextPlans = plan && !currentPlans.some((existingPlan) => existingPlan.id === plan.id)
344	    ? [...currentPlans, plan]
345	    : currentPlans;
346	  const nextRuns = existingRun
347	    ? currentRuns.map((candidate) => candidate.id === run.id ? { ...candidate, ...run } : candidate)
348	    : [run, ...currentRuns];
349	  const nextMessages = message && !(current.messages || []).some((existingMessage) => existingMessage.id === message.id)
350	    ? [...(current.messages || []), message]
351	    : current.messages || [];
352	
353	  return {
354	    ...current,
355	    plans: nextPlans,
356	    runs: nextRuns,
357	    messages: nextMessages,
358	  };
359	}

361	function isCreatedConversationSnapshotServerVisible(
362	  incomingState: EventStreamState,
363	  snapshot: CreatedConversationSnapshot,
364	) {
365	  const run = snapshot.run;
366	  if (!run) {
367	    return false;
368	  }
369	
370	  const hasRun = (incomingState.runs || []).some((existingRun) => existingRun.id === run.id);
371	  const hasPlan = !snapshot.plan || (incomingState.plans || []).some((existingPlan) => existingPlan.id === snapshot.plan?.id);
372	  const hasMessage = !snapshot.message || (incomingState.messages || []).some((existingMessage) => existingMessage.id === snapshot.message?.id);
373	
374	  return hasRun && hasPlan && hasMessage;
375	}

377	function appendServerVisibleCreatedConversationRecords(
378	  current: EventStreamState,
379	  snapshot: CreatedConversationSnapshot,
380	): EventStreamState {
381	  const plan = snapshot.plan;
382	  const message = snapshot.message;
383	  const runId = snapshot.run?.id;
384	  const messageScopeIsComplete = Boolean(
385	    runId
386	    && current.messageScope?.complete
387	    && current.messageScope.runIds.includes(runId),
388	  );
389	  const currentPlans = current.plans || [];
390	  const currentMessages = current.messages || [];
391	  const shouldAppendPlan = Boolean(
392	    plan && !currentPlans.some((existingPlan) => existingPlan.id === plan.id),
393	  );
394	  const shouldAppendMessage = Boolean(
395	    message
396	    && !messageScopeIsComplete
397	    && !currentMessages.some((existingMessage) => existingMessage.id === message.id),
398	  );
399	
400	  if (!shouldAppendPlan && !shouldAppendMessage) {
401	    return current;
402	  }
403	
404	  return {
405	    ...current,
406	    plans: shouldAppendPlan && plan ? [...currentPlans, plan] : currentPlans,
407	    messages: shouldAppendMessage && message ? [...currentMessages, message] : currentMessages,
408	  };
409	}

411	export function mergePendingCreatedConversationSnapshots(
412	  incomingState: EventStreamState,
413	  pendingSnapshots: Map<string, CreatedConversationSnapshot>,
414	  nowMs = Date.now(),
415	): EventStreamState {
416	  if (pendingSnapshots.size === 0) {
417	    return incomingState;
418	  }
419	
420	  let nextState = incomingState;
421	
422	  for (const snapshot of Array.from(pendingSnapshots.values())) {
423	    const incomingHasRun = Boolean(
424	      snapshot.run
425	      && (incomingState.runs || []).some((existingRun) => existingRun.id === snapshot.run?.id),
426	    );
427	    if (isCreatedConversationSnapshotServerVisible(incomingState, snapshot)) {
428	      // A stale in-flight SSE snapshot can still arrive after the server has
429	      // caught up once, so keep the optimistic create snapshot around until an
430	      // explicit delete/archive removes it from the pending map.
431	      snapshot.serverVisibleAtMs ??= nowMs;
432	      continue;
433	    }
434	
435	    if (snapshot.serverVisibleAtMs !== undefined && incomingHasRun) {
436	      // Selected-run snapshots intentionally omit messages from other runs.
437	      // Preserve any out-of-scope creation records without merging the old
438	      // creation-time run over the server's newer lifecycle status.
439	      nextState = appendServerVisibleCreatedConversationRecords(nextState, snapshot);
440	      continue;
441	    }
442	
443	    nextState = appendCreatedConversationSnapshot(nextState, snapshot);
444	  }
445	
446	  return nextState;
447	}

461	export function shouldShowConversationExecutionPanel({
462	  selectedRun,
463	  isConversationThinking,
464	  executionEventCount,
465	}: {
466	  selectedRun: RunRecord | null;
467	  isConversationThinking: boolean;
468	  executionEventCount: number;
469	}) {
470	  if (!selectedRun) {
471	    return false;
472	  }
473	  // A non-terminal run is always "running enough" to deserve the panel,
474	  // even if the derived signals (active workers, recent events) flicker
475	  // across a snapshot refresh or a supervisor wake/sleep gap.
476	  if (ACTIVE_RUN_STATUSES_FOR_EXECUTION_PANEL.has(selectedRun.status)) {
477	    return true;
478	  }
479	  return isConversationThinking || executionEventCount > 0;
480	}
```

```text
1	export type BusyMessageAction = "queue" | "steer";
2	export type BusyComposerButtonKind = "send" | "stop";
3	export type BusyComposerSubmitAction = "send_normal" | "send_queue" | "send_steer" | "stop";
4	
5	export type BusyComposerBehavior = {
6	  buttonKind: BusyComposerButtonKind;
7	  submitAction: BusyComposerSubmitAction;
8	  ariaLabelKey: string;
9	  allowAlternateBusyAction: boolean;
10	};
11	
12	export function parseBusyMessageAction(value: string | null | undefined): BusyMessageAction {
13	  return value === "steer" ? "steer" : "queue";
14	}
15	
16	export function isManualStopCommand(value: string) {
17	  const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
18	  return normalized === "stop" || normalized === "/stop";
19	}
20	
21	export function resolveBusyComposerBehavior({
22	  hasBusyConversation,
23	  isConversationStoppable,
24	  hasContent,
25	  busyMessageAction,
26	  forceSteer,
27	}: {
28	  hasBusyConversation: boolean;
29	  isConversationStoppable: boolean;
30	  hasContent: boolean;
31	  busyMessageAction: BusyMessageAction;
32	  forceSteer?: boolean;
33	}): BusyComposerBehavior {
34	  if (isConversationStoppable && !hasContent) {
35	    return {
36	      buttonKind: "stop",
37	      submitAction: "stop",
38	      ariaLabelKey: "conversation.composer.sendButton.stop",
39	      allowAlternateBusyAction: false,
40	    };
41	  }
42	
43	  if (hasBusyConversation && hasContent) {
44	    return busyMessageAction === "steer" || forceSteer
45	      ? {
46	          buttonKind: "send",
47	          submitAction: "send_steer",
48	          ariaLabelKey: "conversation.composer.sendButton.steer",
49	          allowAlternateBusyAction: !forceSteer,
50	        }
51	      : {
52	          buttonKind: "send",
53	          submitAction: "send_queue",
54	          ariaLabelKey: "conversation.composer.sendButton.queue",
55	          allowAlternateBusyAction: true,
56	        };
57	  }
58	
59	  return {
60	    buttonKind: "send",
61	    submitAction: "send_normal",
62	    ariaLabelKey: "conversation.composer.sendButton.send",
63	    allowAlternateBusyAction: false,
64	  };
65	}
66	
67	export function resolveBusyMessageActionForSubmitAction(
68	  submitAction: BusyComposerSubmitAction,
69	  options: { useAlternate?: boolean } = {},
70	): BusyMessageAction | undefined {
71	  if (submitAction === "send_queue") {
72	    return options.useAlternate ? "steer" : "queue";
73	  }
74	
75	  if (submitAction === "send_steer") {
76	    return options.useAlternate ? "queue" : "steer";
77	  }
78	
79	  return undefined;
80	}
81
```

```text
156	export function getTerminalActivityVersion(activity: TerminalActivityItem[]) {
157	  return activity.map((item) => {
158	    switch (item.kind) {
159	      case "pending_assistant":
160	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.status}`;
161	      case "thinking":
162	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.timestamp}:${item.inProgress}:${item.thoughts.join("\n").length}`;
163	      case "tool":
164	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.timestamp}:${item.status}:${item.title.length}:${item.inputPane?.text.length ?? 0}:${item.outputPane?.text.length ?? 0}`;
165	      case "tool_group":
166	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.timestamp}:${item.status}:${item.tools.length}:${item.tools.map((tool) => `${tool.id}:${tool.status}:${tool.title.length}:${tool.inputPane?.text.length ?? 0}:${tool.outputPane?.text.length ?? 0}`).join(",")}`;
167	      case "permission":
168	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.timestamp}:${item.status}:${item.title.length}:${item.text.length}:${item.detail?.length ?? 0}`;
169	      case "message":
170	      case "user_message":
171	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.timestamp}:${item.text.length}`;
172	      case "work_summary":
173	        return `${item.id}:${item.kind}:${item.durationMs}:${item.inProgress}:${item.items.length}`;
174	    }
175	  }).join("|");
176	}

250	  variant,
251	  isFirstRenderedActivity,

253	}: {

255	  isFirstRenderedActivity: boolean;
```
